On what date did DeepSeek release its open-weight reasoning model DeepSeek-R1?

[DeepSeek] Hangzhou DeepSeek Artificial Intelligence Basic Technology Research Co., Ltd., doing business as DeepSeek, is a Chinese artificial intelligence (AI) company that develops open weights large language models (LLMs). Based in Hangzhou, Zhejiang, DeepSeek is owned and funded by High-Flyer, a Chinese hedge fund.

The company launched an eponymous chatbot alongside its DeepSeek-R1 model in January 2025.
On 20 January 2025, DeepSeek launched the DeepSeek-R1 model, which was free for iOS and Android.
On 28 May 2025, DeepSeek released DeepSeek-R1-0528 under the MIT License, which was a minor update upon R1.

DeepSeek released its open-weight reasoning model DeepSeek-R1 on January 20, 2025. 

FINAL: January 20, 2025
